# GrayMatter Context

This file contains persistent memory traces for use as AI agent context.

## Decisions & Planning
> Architecture choices, goals, strategies, and high-level decisions

- The application is designed as a modular React-based "Paper Doll" engine. It separates the State Logic (the engine) from the Presentation Layer (the UI), allowing for easy integration of both static assets and GenAI content. _(application, designed, modular)_
- (Auto-generated placeholder. Please fill this in.) _(autogenerated, placeholder, please)_
- Cinema Archive is a specialized tool designed to generate high-quality Midjourney prompts for recreating iconic movie scenes. It allows users to combine specific movie scenes with various artistic styles and configuration parameters to create unique AI-generated imagery. _(cinema, archive, specialized)_
- **Data Architecture**: Massive static dataset (`/data`) containing scenes, seasons, episodes, and style definitions for hundreds of media properties. _(architecture, massive, static)_
- **Improved UI Architecture**: Refactored the main application into a more modular structure for better performance. _(improved, architecture, refactored)_
- **Glassmorphism UI**: Implemented a modern, premium design with translucent layers and vibrant gradients. _(glassmorphism, implemented, modern)_

## Technical Knowledge
> Code patterns, frameworks, stack details, and structural information

- zindex: Determines rendering order. _(zindex, determines, rendering)_
- compatibilitytags: Ensures items fit the selected character (e.g. "Don Draper"). _(compatibilitytags, ensures, items)_
- assets: Contains URLs to the layers (supporting transparency). _(assets, contains, layers)_
- The core logic is encapsulated in useFashionEngine. _(logic, encapsulated, usefashionengine)_
- Items are automatically sorted for rendering based on their zindex.
Default Hierarchy:
Accessories (Index: 70-100)
Coats (Index: 60)
Dresses / Tops (Index: 40-50)
Bottoms (Index: 45) - Note: Interacts with tucking logic
Shoes (Index: 30)
Base Character (Index: 0) _(items, automatically, sorted)_
- Single Slot Categories: Logic ensures only one Hat, Shoe pair, or Coat is worn at a time. _(single, categories, logic)_
- Multi-Slot Exceptions: Accessories allow multiple items (e.g., Necklace + Cigarette). _(multislot, exceptions, accessories)_
- Static: Stored in public/assets. High-res PNGs. _(static, stored, publicassets)_

- View Generated Examples on Midjourney _(generated, examples, midjourney)_
- Here are some examples of images generated using prompts from this tool: _(examples, images, generated)_
- Movie Selection: Browse and select from a curated list of movies (e.g., Top Gun). _(movie, selection, browse)_
- Scene Library: Access a detailed collection of scenes for each movie, complete with descriptions. _(scene, library, access)_
- Advanced Configuration: _(advanced, configuration)_
- Midjourney Version: Support for v5, v6, v6.1, and v7. _(midjourney, version, support)_
- Aspect Ratio: Choose from a wide range of aspect ratios (e.g., 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 2:3). _(aspect, ratio, choose)_
- Stylize: Fine-tune the artistic influence with a customizable stylize parameter (0-1000). _(stylize, finetune, artistic)_
- Instant Generation: Real-time prompt construction as you make selections. _(instant, generation, realtime)_
- One-Click Copy: Easily copy the generated prompt to your clipboard for use in Midjourney. _(oneclick, easily, generated)_
- To run this project locally, follow these steps: _(project, locally, follow)_
- Clone the repository (if applicable) or navigate to the project directory. _(clone, repository, applicable)_
- Install dependencies: _(install, dependencies)_
- bash
    npm install _(install)_
- Start the development server: _(start, development, server)_
- bash
    npm run dev
- 📚 Complete Media Library - A-Z index of all 295+ titles. _(complete, media, library)_
- 📦 Media Package - Official promotional assets and brand material. _(media, package, official)_
- ☕ Support the Project - Help us reach the 50-scene standard for every movie. _(support, project, reach)_
- 📜 Legal | Terms _(legal, terms)_
- Frontend Framework: React 19 _(frontend, framework, react)_
- Language: TypeScript _(language, typescript)_
- Icons: Lucide React _(icons, lucide, react)_
- This document lists all movies with their exact image filenames.
Save all poster images to: public/posters/ _(document, lists, movies)_
- File Format: PNG or WebP (recommended)
Naming Convention: {movie-id}.png or {movie-id}.webp
Recommended Size: 800x1200px (2:3 aspect ratio) _(format, recommended, naming)_
- ---
- Generate Posters: Use the Poster Mode in the app to copy poster prompts
Save Images: Save each generated image with the exact filename listed above
Upload: Place all images in public/posters/
Deploy: Run npm run deploy to update the live site _(generate, posters, poster)_
- Movies marked with ✅ have pre-written poster prompts _(movies, marked, prewritten)_
- Movies marked with ❌ will need manual prompts or won't show backgrounds _(movies, marked, manual)_
- Use 2:3 aspect ratio for best results _(aspect, ratio, results)_
- **State Management**: Complex filtering and sorting logic (by Genre, Decade, Director) and "Randomizer" functionality with locking mechanisms. _(state, management, complex)_
- **Unified Media Library**: Support for **Movies**, **TV Series** (with Season/Episode granular selection), and **Video Games**. _(unified, media, library)_
- **Studio Hub Integration**: Includes a dashboard of other available "SRE Studio" apps and their repositories. _(studio, integration, includes)_
- `/src/data`: The heart of the app. Contains `movies.ts`, `series.ts`, `games.ts`, and the massive `scenes` database. _(srcdata, heart, contains)_
- `/src/App.tsx`: The main "Pro Dashboard" interface. _(srcapptsx, dashboard, interface)_
- `/src/AppV3.tsx`: A legacy or alternative interface version. _(srcappvtsx, legacy, alternative)_
- `Research/`: Contains background research and lists used to populate the database. _(research, contains, background)_
- **Poster Prompts**: Added `posterPrompt` field to `Movie` interface in `types.ts`. _(poster, prompts, added)_
- **Content Upgrade**: Added official movie poster prompts for over 50 "Elite" and "Classic" movies (e.g., *Top Gun, Matrix, Godfather, Alien, Blade Runner*). _(content, upgrade, added)_
- **Elite V7 Standard**: Upgraded 10 legendary films to the new "Elite" prompt standard (50 High-Detail scenes each). _(elite, standard, upgraded)_
- **Cinematic Descriptions**: Every new scene now includes detailed camera angles, lighting, and atmosphere metadata. _(cinematic, descriptions, scene)_
- **Movies Upgraded**: *The Godfather, Alien, Blade Runner, Apocalypse Now, 2001: A Space Odyssey, A Clockwork Orange, Psycho, Full Metal Jacket, Shawshank Redemption, Schindler's List*. _(movies, upgraded, godfather)_
- **Codebase Optimization**: Cleaned up fragmented scene data and removed 100+ duplicate scene definitions. _(codebase, optimization, cleaned)_
- **Massive Content Drop**: Expanded the scene database to ensure major franchises and categories have 50 scenes per title. _(massive, content, expanded)_
- **Enhanced Search**: Implemented more robust filtering by Genre and Category. _(enhanced, search, implemented)_
- **Cleaned Data**: Resolved hundreds of duplicate imports and mapping errors in `scenes.ts`. _(cleaned, resolved, hundreds)_
- Added *Classic Movies 1 & 2* containing 100+ iconic cinema moments. _(added, classic, movies)_
- Introduced *Horror Classics* and *Eighties Action* categories. _(introduced, horror, classics)_
- Basic scene mapping system established. _(basic, scene, mapping)_
- Added support for large movie franchises: *Fast & Furious*, *Back to the Future*, *Indiana Jones*. _(added, support, movie)_
- Implemented the first version of the Scene Selector. _(implemented, version, scene)_
- Core prompter functionality. _(prompter, functionality)_
- Initial set of 20 blockbusters including *Top Gun*, *The Matrix*, and *Inception*. _(initial, blockbusters, including)_
- Basic copy-to-clipboard functionality. _(basic, copytoclipboard, functionality)_

- **State Management**: Complex filtering and sorting logic (by Genre, Decade, Director) and "Randomizer" functionality with locking mechanisms. _(state, management, complex)_ _(state, management, complex)_
- **Unified Media Library**: Support for **Movies**, **TV Series** (with Season/Episode granular selection), and **Video Games**. _(unified, media, library)_ _(unified, media, library)_
- **Studio Hub Integration**: Includes a dashboard of other available "SRE Studio" apps and their repositories. _(studio, integration, includes)_ _(studio, integration, includes)_
- `/src/data`: The heart of the app. Contains `movies.ts`, `series.ts`, `games.ts`, and the massive `scenes` database. _(srcdata, heart, contains)_ _(srcdata, heart, contains)_
- `/src/App.tsx`: The main "Pro Dashboard" interface. _(srcapptsx, dashboard, interface)_ _(srcapptsx, dashboard, interface)_
- `/src/AppV3.tsx`: A legacy or alternative interface version. _(srcappvtsx, legacy, alternative)_ _(srcappvtsx, legacy, alternative)_
- `Research/`: Contains background research and lists used to populate the database. _(research, contains, background)_ _(research, contains, background)_

- Dress vs. Separates: Equipping a Dress automatically removes any equipped Top or Bottom. Conversely, equipping a Top or Bottom removes the Dress. _(dress, separates, equipping)_
- Generative: The app handles isgenerated: true items. These are created via an API call (e.g., Stable Diffusion with ControlNet) using the genaimetadata prompts, and returned as temporary ClothingItem objects to be equipped immediately. _(generative, handles, isgenerated)_

- Description: Premium marketing shot featuring the glassmorphic UI against a backdrop of iconic cinema. _(description, premium, marketing)_

- TopGun Prompter is the ultimate creative companion for AI artists, filmmakers, and digital creators. Inspired by the visual storytelling of cinema, this application provides an exhaustive database of iconic movie and video game scenes, meticulously curated to help you generate stunning visual prompts. _(topgun, prompter, ultimate)_
- Visual Styles: Every title includes custom-engineered style prompts that capture the specific "vibe" of the director—from the grit of David Fincher to the neon glow of Denis Villeneuve. _(visual, styles, title)_
- We believe that AI generation is most powerful when grounded in the history of visual arts. TopGun Prompter bridges the gap between your imagination and the technical requirements of AI prompt engineering by providing the "DNA" of cinematic history as your starting point. _(believe, generation, powerful)_
- Samuel Erwin is a visionary digital artist and developer with a passion for the intersection of traditional cinematography and modern AI technology. With an eagle eye for visual detail and a background in photography (SREphoto), Samuel created TopGun Prompter to democratize high-level cinematic prompt engineering. _(samuel, erwin, visionary)_
- His mission is to ensure that every digital creator, regardless of their technical background, can harness the visual language of the world's greatest directors. Based in Minnesota, Samuel continues to expand the Cinema Archive, meticulously curating thousands of scenes to build the world's most detailed prompt database. _(mission, ensure, digital)_

- Standard Styles: Global styles available for all movies. _(standard, styles, global)_
- Unique Styles: Custom styles tailored specifically to the selected movie. _(unique, styles, custom)_
- Select a Movie: Choose a film from the horizontal scroll bar at the top.
Select a Scene: Pick a specific scene from the grid. Each scene includes a title and ID.
Choose a Style: Select an artistic style from the left sidebar. You can choose from "Unique Styles" (specific to the movie) or "Standard Styles".
Configure Settings: Adjust the Midjourney version, aspect ratio, and stylize value in the left sidebar.
Generate & Copy: The prompt is automatically generated in the "Output" terminal on the right. Click "COPY PROMPT" to save it to your clipboard. _(select, movie, choose)_

- **Frontend**: React (Vite) with an information-dense, dashboard-style UI. _(frontend, react, informationdense)_
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with theming support (including special themes like "Christmas" or "War" based on the selected media). _(styling, tailwind, theming)_
- **Prompt builder**: Interactive workspace to combine a `[Scene Description]` with a `[Visual Style]` + parameters (Aspect Ratio, Stylize, Niji version). _(prompt, builder, interactive)_
- **Smart Randomizer 🎲**: A "Slot Machine" mode for creativity, allowing users to lock specific variables (e.g., "Keep the Movie, roll for a random Scene and Style"). _(smart, randomizer, machine)_
- **Tech Specs Toggle**: Quick switches for Midjourney parameters like `--v 6.0`, `--style raw`, `--tile`, `--ar`. _(specs, toggle, quick)_
- **Top 100 Analytics**: Visual indicators for movies that topped the box office in their respective years. _(analytics, visual, indicators)_
- **Visual Enhancement**: Enabled high-quality poster generation for UI backgrounds. _(visual, enhancement, enabled)_
